label: Blush Maroon
description: A modern fine-jewellery storefront: crisp white page, blush-pink panels and badges, and a deep maroon for buttons and prices. Lato throughout, like the big online jewellery brands.
notes: Modelled on the GIVA storefront (giva.co): Lato for headings and body at regular weight, near-black #121212 text, blush #FFB9C7 to #FFE5EA gradient buttons and pink badges, a maroon #832729 accent, 6-7px corners. Pairs with the slideshow, categories, banners and features sections.
_contrastNote: Measured: text 18.73:1 on bg; primary 9.18:1 on bg and 8.37:1 on surface (white on primary 9.18:1); accent 6.21:1 / 5.66:1; muted 5.85:1 / 5.33:1; text on the blush secondary 11.61:1. All clear WCAG AA.
